subject: Film & Cinema
title: The Biopic: Real Lives, Edited Stories
description: A fast breakdown of The Biopic: Real Lives, Edited Stories for builders.

hook.text: Biopics promise true stories. They almost never deliver the full truth.

buildup.text: Filmmakers compress decades into two hours, cutting facts that don't serve the narrative.

discovery.text: The best biopics capture the essence of a person rather than a literal timeline.

twist.text: Audiences often remember the movie version of events, not the real history.

climax.text: Biopics shape public memory — for better and worse — every award season.

punchline.text: A true story on screen is never quite true.

quiz.question: Why are biopics rarely completely accurate?
options: Real lives must be compressed and edited for narrative
